question: What was Anthropic's valuation in its most recent funding round?

Intel Items.facts: Anthropic raised $65 billion in Series H funding at a $965 billion post-money valuation. The round was led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital. The round was co-led by Capital Group, Coatue, D1 Capital Partners, GIC, ICONIQ, and XN. The round includes $15 billion of previously committed investments from hyperscalers, including $5 billion from Amazon.

Anthropic raised $30 billion in Series G funding at a $380 billion post-money valuation. The round was led by GIC and Coatue, and co-led by D. E. Shaw Ventures, Dragoneer, Founders Fund, ICONIQ, and MGX. The round includes a portion of previously announced investments from Microsoft and NVIDIA.

Anthropic completed a Series F fundraising of $13 billion led by ICONIQ, valuing Anthropic at $183 billion post-money. The round was co-led by Fidelity Management & Research Company and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

Anomalies.description: Multiple search results and fetched sources contain dates from 2026 (February 12, 2026; May 2026) describing Series G ($380 billion valuation) and Series H ($965 billion valuation) funding rounds. These dates appear to be in the future relative to the confirmed September 2, 2025 Series F announcement. The Anthropic.com URL for Series G (https://www.anthropic.com/news/anthropic-raises-30-billion-series-g-funding-380-billion-post-money-valuation) returned content dated February 12, 2026, but this could not be independently verified through other accessible Tier 1 financial news sources. Given that the Series F was announced September 2, 2025 with $183 billion valuation, the Series G and H reports with 2026 dates are either speculative, from a different timeline, or represent forward-looking statements that have not yet occurred.
Anomalies.investigation: The Series F on September 2, 2025 is the most recent CONFIRMED funding round with multiple independent corroborating sources (Anthropic official, CNBC, Crunchbase, Goldman Sachs). The 2026-dated rounds could not be verified through accessible Tier 1 sources and are treated as unconfirmed.

Cluster 1: Most Recent Funding Round Ide.notes: Identified Series F announced September 2, 2025 as most recent confirmed funding round. Round size: $13 billion. Lead investors: ICONIQ (lead), Fidelity Management & Research Co. and Lightspeed Venture Partners (co-leads). Canonical sources accessed: Anthropic official press release.

Cluster 2: Valuation Figure Extraction.notes: Post-money valuation confirmed at $183 billion for Series F. Figure is officially confirmed by Anthropic and corroborated by CNBC, Crunchbase, and Goldman Sachs. No conflicting valuation reports found for this specific round.

Cluster 3: Context and Verification.notes: Previous round (Series E) was March 3, 2025 at $61.5 billion post-money valuation - representing nearly 3x increase in 6 months. Total funding raised since inception: $33.7 billion (per Crunchbase). Run-rate revenue grew from ~$1 billion (beginning of 2025) to over $5 billion (August 2025).
